title: assay.status/1
description: A PR's assay state as `assay status --json` renders it (docs/architecture/03-contracts.md §6b): the App's verdict check, the decision its evidence pointer names, the per-gate checks, the decision's findings and the viewer. Every text is one assay already published, sanitised (04 §6, T8); nothing is raw model text. With `source: local` (`assay status --json --local`, #130) it is instead the advisory local check of the working tree: no PR, no App check, no viewer, nothing waivable, and finding text cleaned onto one line as the terminal report shows it. Unknown fields are rejected.

source.description: Where the state was read: `ci`, the published verdict; `local`, the advisory result of `assay check --local` (02 §6), which CI never reads.

head_sha.description: The PR's head commit, the commit the checks are read on.

local_head_sha.description: The local checkout's HEAD, or null when there is none.

tree.description: Local only: the tree fingerprint (02 §6) the local result is about, or null when there is none.

local_tree.description: Local only: the working tree's fingerprint when the state was read.

stale.description: `ci`: whether the local HEAD is known and differs from `head_sha`. `local`: whether there is a local result and its `tree` differs from `local_tree`.

check.description: The `assay-verdict` App's verdict check on `head_sha`, or null when it has none yet. A same-named check from any other app is ignored. `local`: the local result as a check would show it (no `url`), or null when there is no local result.

decision.description: The decision the check's evidence pointer names (assay.decision/1, 03 §5). Null only when there is none to read: no App verdict check, a check carrying `open`'s `pending:<run>:<seq>` stamp (a run in progress), or a decided check whose run persisted no bundle (a refused run persists none, and its status says why in `refused`). A decided `pending` verdict (its check stays `in_progress`), such as a budget deferral, carries its decision. `local`: the local decision, null when there is no local result.

refused.description: `ci` only (#218): why the run was refused before the rubric, so a refusal is not read as nothing having run. Present only when the App's verdict check is completed `failure` and its `output.text` names neither an inputs digest nor an evidence pointer (a refused run persists no bundle, so `decision` is null); absent for every other check. `reason` is the one reason code of 03 §5 that check's title carries; anything else is refused, never guessed.

tier.description: The decision's tier (04 §2.3), or null without a decision.

gates.description: The App's `assay / gate: <plugin>` checks on `head_sha`, by plugin name.

findings.description: The decision's gate and reviewer findings, one per fingerprint, gate findings first. Text comes only from the App's published inline comment for the fingerprint; it is null when none was published.

finding_id.description: The id `/assay waive <finding-id>` takes: the fingerprint.

title.description: The published title, as escaped for GitHub (04 §6).

waivable.description: Whether `/assay waive` may clear it: R-08(a) and #59, exactly as decide applies a waiver.

body.description: With `--full`: the rest of the published comment, as escaped for GitHub.

weigh_in.description: What the required Weigh-In gate reported, as the domain's code (03 §2.2, 04 §9): `clear` (nothing blocks), `open-blocking` (an open blocking item), `pending-triage` (items awaiting triage) or `no-evidence` (no evidence for the change; the decision fails on it). Absent when the gate is not required or there is no decision, and always for `local`: Weigh-In does not run locally, so a required one shows as the decision's `weigh-in-no-evidence` reason.

aeu.description: Reserved: what the run's LLM stage cost. Not emitted until a contract carries it.

viewer.description: The `gh` user running the command, checked against the base P10 owner set and `.assay/agents` by numeric id. Informational only (#137): decide-only re-checks every action.

fetched_at.description: When the state was read: an RFC 3339 date-time; `assay status` writes UTC with a `Z`.

tree.description: A git tree id: SHA-1 or SHA-256, lowercase hex.

fp.description: Finding fingerprint computed by Z4: 16 lowercase hex digits (03 §3).

item.description: One published list item: control and format characters replaced, at most 200 characters and a closing ellipsis.

url.description: A github.com page of the repository.

checkConclusion.description: GitHub's check conclusion, or null before the check completes.
